statements.text: In conversations with many of the President’s National Security and Economic advisors, we talked about the impact of these frontier AI models, and that it would not be misplaced to refer to their capabilities as akin to digital nuclear weapons.
statements.context: Remarks as Prepared for Delivery by Central Intelligence Agency Director John Ratcliffe at the Amazon Web Services Summit, Washington, DC, June 30, 2026

attribution.speaker: John Ratcliffe
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: We can’t afford to wait for a risk-free approach to emerging technology. It doesn’t exist. We have to move fast. We have to be aggressive. And we have to take full advantage of the ingenuity that sets America apart.
statements.context: Remarks as Prepared for Delivery by Central Intelligence Agency Director John Ratcliffe at the Amazon Web Services Summit, Washington, DC, June 30, 2026

attribution.speaker: John Ratcliffe
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: So, we must not just incorporate emerging technology, we must master it better than our adversaries.
statements.context: Remarks as Prepared for Delivery by Central Intelligence Agency Director John Ratcliffe at the Amazon Web Services Summit, Washington, DC, June 30, 2026

attribution.speaker: John Ratcliffe

statements.text: That’s why, when I became Director, I made clear that emerging technologies was right up there with China as our top priority.

attribution.speaker: John Ratcliffe

statements.text: And our adversaries across the globe see it, as they work to steal and manipulate America’s advancements for their own ends.
statements.context: Remarks as Prepared for Delivery by Central Intelligence Agency Director John Ratcliffe at the Amazon Web Services Summit, Washington, DC, June 30, 2026

statements.text: Finally, our widespread adoption of AI is transforming the way we do business. And it must, because the worldwide advancement of AI tools will only continue to raise the stakes in our competition with our adversaries.
statements.context: Remarks as Prepared for Delivery by Central Intelligence Agency Director John Ratcliffe at the Amazon Web Services Summit, Washington, DC, June 30, 2026

attribution.speaker: John Ratcliffe
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Advances in AI, quantum, and biotech are not just going to profoundly impact economies; they are rewriting the reality of conflict.
statements.context: Remarks as Prepared for Delivery by Central Intelligence Agency Director John Ratcliffe at the Amazon Web Services Summit, Washington, DC, June 30, 2026

attribution.speaker: John Ratcliffe

statements.text: A great illustration of this is how AI-powered robots and drones can help scaled manufacturing achieve exponentially better speed and efficiency. But on the battlefield, their efficiency and lethality can be equally devastating.
statements.context: Remarks as Prepared for Delivery by Central Intelligence Agency Director John Ratcliffe at the Amazon Web Services Summit, Washington, DC, June 30, 2026

statements.text: It is for these reasons that emerging technologies—and AI, in particular—is a domain in which CIA must excel because every algorithmic decision, every byte of data has implications for U.S. strategic advantage and for the national security of our people.
